question: What is the parent technique of attack technique 'T1558.001: Steal or Forge Kerberos Tickets: Golden Ticket'?
answer_text:
Gathered 1 record(s) from 1 source(s).
The ATT&CK record for T1558.001 (Golden Ticket) states that adversaries who have the KRBTGT account password hash may forge Kerberos ticket-granting tickets (TGT), also known as a golden ticket. Golden tickets enable adversaries to generate authentication material for any account in Active Directory. Using a golden ticket, adversaries are then able to request ticket granting service (TGS) tickets, which enable access to specific resources.
